title: Restore lean_core_ceilings pillar and runtime budgets and guard Linux-only systemd stop helper
goal: Extract inline #[cfg(test)] modules out of crates/susi-gawd/src/{compliance,reflex_synth}.rs and crates/susi-gmcp/src/tools/helpers.rs into src/tests/, compact multi-line test formatting so test_rust <= 128,550, and guard stop_systemd_units_with on Windows without modifying tests/lean_core_ceilings.rs.
limitations: Restores `lean_core_ceilings` (`3/3`) and Windows `dead_code` cleanliness after upstream `T-AGYE2ECORE-1` without raising any ceiling constants; GMCP append-only evidence refresh runs next in `T-CODEXGMCPROADMAP-113`.

reuse.why: Extracted inline `#[cfg(test)]` modules into `src/tests/` via `#[path = "..."]`, compacted vertical test formatting, and guarded Linux-only `stop_systemd_units_with` with `#[cfg(any(target_os = "linux", test))]` without modifying any `lean_core_ceilings.rs` budget constants or runtime behavior.
